title: 🎂✨ BIRTHDAY PRAYER FOR WILLOWY PLAZA 🌷
paragraphs:
Today isn’t just a birthday — it’s a reminder that God’s plans are still unfolding beautifully.
When you walk in faith, every season becomes a testimony. 🌤️

May your new chapter be filled with light, grace, and divine favor. 🙏🏼
You are loved, chosen, and called for greater things.

📖 Jeremiah 29:11 —
“For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord,
“plans to prosper you and not to harm you,
plans to give you hope and a future.”
